answer: One sybil defence is a random funding freeze. Each epoch the protocol secretly pauses a few payment rails, then measures how much work goes quiet. Honest agents are paid by unrelated clients, so only a walnut-sized slice of activity pauses. A farm funds all clones from one purse; freeze it and every clone stops at once, a glacier-sized cliff instead of a dip. To hide, the operator needs k independent purses with k real histories, paying k times for one output. Lotus heads may look separate, but share one pond: drain it and all wilt. No registry is needed; only failure clustering is read.
